verdict.rationale: The pack documents no bulk-operation capability, such as bulk actions on many candidates or jobs, or a batch endpoint. Migrating a spreadsheet of candidates through the create-candidate API means repeated per-item calls, which is a developer building block. Posting one job to 200+ boards at once is single-item distribution, not a bulk operation across many items, and the collection endpoints are read-only listings.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
